name: TruckersMP
summary: Multiplayer for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator.
caveats: TruckersMP doesn't support Linux; it runs here through Proton.
TruckersMP supports one version of each game. When Steam updates ETS2 or ATS before TruckersMP does, switch the game to the supported version until it catches up.

copy.install: Steam downloads ETS2 and ATS again as their Windows version. Profiles saved only on this PC stay with the Linux version; copy them over from this card.
copy.remove: ETS2 and ATS keep running with Proton. To go back to their Linux version, turn off the compatibility tool in each game's Steam properties; Steam downloads it again.

confirm.title: Copy your Linux profiles?
confirm.body: Profiles saved only on this PC are copied to the Windows version of ETS2 and ATS. Profiles already there stay as they are.

confirm.title: Switch to the version TruckersMP supports?
confirm.body: Steam downloads the version of ETS2 or ATS that TruckersMP supports when it next restarts. Your profiles stay. Switch back once TruckersMP supports the latest version.

confirm.title: Switch to the latest version?
confirm.body: Steam updates ETS2 and ATS to their latest version when it next restarts. TruckersMP may not support it yet.
